versions.changelog:
- Initial release of gemini-openai-chat-export-analyze.
- Supports exporting and analyzing full chat history from Gemini (Google) and ChatGPT (OpenAI) web versions, not including API or third-party clients.
- Provides step-by-step user guides for both ChatGPT JSON exports and Gemini HTML exports.
- Outlines key differences: ChatGPT exports JSON, Gemini uses HTML.
- Includes analysis commands and scripts for converting exported data into structured, searchable formats.
- Details privacy considerations and common pitfalls with exports from both platforms.
